routeAudit.method: All existing rows compared with the complete Wizard table; sparse/contradictory cases cross-checked against numbered KHWiki world tables, KHGuides, Thundaka, TrueAchievements and GamerGuides. Every entry now includes the area and a working landmark/approach. Growth levels are route choices, not minimum claims.
qualifications: Daylight 27: synthesis-shop roof versus central-pillar landmark remains inconsistent; both descriptions use the tram.
Sunset 32/36/40: shared three-crown Glide route is verified, but individual pipe-to-piece order is not.
Thundaka v1.10 requires Final Form MAX for the three Glide crowns; modern TrueAchievements explicitly supports base Glide LV3, consistent with KHWiki and Wizard. No universal-minimum claim is made.
Daylight 28 retains Station Heights; Wizard incorrectly labels a Tram Common pillar.
Daylight 10/11/37 platform assignments resolved using the numbered world Journal crosswalk.
